content:
In June, Anthropic first released its Mythos-class AI model Fable 5 designed for Claude. Three months later, Anthropic further enhanced Claude with the new Fable 5.1 model upgrade.

Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 officially launched today

In Anthropic's world, Fable is Claude's most capable model. Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus are the small, medium, and large models under Fable.

Anthropic stated: "Claude Fable 5.1 has set new standards in programming, knowledge work, and long-horizon problem-solving tasks." The company noted that the new model's performance level is higher than Fable 5.

Anthropic also stated that when Fable 5.1 is configured at low or medium effort, it can "achieve similar or better results than Fable 5 at a lower cost".

Here is more news from Anthropic:

In addition to Fable 5.1, users with Mythos access can also use Mythos 5.1.

Anthropic explained: "Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are the same model, just with different levels of safety guardrails. Fable 5.1 is fully open for use, while Mythos 5.1 is only available through our trusted access programme; its safety guardrails are specifically designed for work in cybersecurity and life sciences."

Here is the pricing information for Fable 5.1:

Regarding pricing, Anthropic stated that it has "lowered the fees for Fable 5.1 cache reads (i.e., the model reusing already-processed context) for any usage billed by token, such as on our API platform." The company noted that this move "significantly reduces the overall cost of running the model." Apart from this, pricing remains unchanged from Fable 5.
